name: Inlet header
function: The large-bore pipe on the skid that receives the treating line from the missile and distributes it to each well branch.

tabs.overview: The header is a forged or fabricated pressure vessel rated with the stack, with a branch outlet per well and an inlet at one or both ends; a bleed valve and a pressure transducer are fitted on the header.
tabs.engineering: API 6A pressure-containing component rated to the stack working pressure.
tabs.safety: The header holds treating pressure whenever any branch is open to a well; it is bled through the bleed valve, never by breaking a connection.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
